主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced a proposed offering of US$350 million in notes. The filing was submitted to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on January 12, 2015, as part of a Form 6-K report. The filing includes an exhibit titled 'BROOKFIELD ASSET MANAGEMENT ANNOUNCES PROPOSED OFFERING OF US$350 MILLION NOTES.' The report was signed by A.J. Silber, the Corporate Secretary of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. This filing is part of the company's regulatory disclosures and does not provide specific financial results or market performance details.
